newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET - S.AFRICA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - S.AFRICA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and batted first against India in Thursday's opening match of the Titan Cup triangular one-day series.
Australia complete the line-up for the competition in which each team plays each other three times.
The top two will contest the final in Bombay on November 6.
South Africa: Gary Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Dave Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Pat Symcox, Derek Crookes, Brian McMillan, Dave Richardson, Fanie de Villiers, Allan Donald.
India: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Sujith Somasundar, Rahul Dravid, Saurav Ganguly, Mohammed Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Nayan Mongia, Sunil Joshi, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad.
